Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

bruce 0.1.1

  • bruce_covariates() accepts a named list of rasters, each kept in its own projection and resolution and read directly at stations and background cells, with no resampling to a common grid. New na_value argument sets the raw value used where a raster has no data (e.g. c(urb = 0)).
  • bruce_predict() and bruce_decompose() read each covariate from its native raster: resample = "near" takes the raster’s value at each grid cell centre; "average" and "bilinear" project onto the grid.
  • Validated against the Rio de Janeiro article fit (January 2025, daily median): with identical inputs, all fixed effects within 0.03 posterior sd and spatial range 7682 m vs 7669 m.

bruce 0.1.0

  • First version: data contract (bruce_data(), bruce_covariates()), mesh, model specification and fitting with collapse detection (bruce_mesh(), bruce_spec(), bruce_fit(), bruce_check()), prediction, decomposition and zonal aggregation (bruce_predict(), bruce_decompose(), bruce_zonal()), leave-station-out and leave-region-out validation with CRPS (bruce_cv()) and a synthetic city simulator (bruce_simulate()).
